blocks.text: P2P CAR RENTAL — DAMAGE PROTECTION / EXCESS INSURANCE WAIVER
This Damage Protection Addendum is attached to the Peer-to-Peer Car Rental Agreement dated {{agreement_date}} between {{owner_name}} ("Owner") and {{renter_name}} ("Renter").
Renter may purchase damage protection through {{insurance_provider}} or directly through the rental platform. The following options are available:

rows: Renter is responsible for the full deductible under Owner's insurance policy, plus any damage exceeding insurance limits and loss of use.
All damage responsibility falls on Renter per the main rental agreement.

Damage from driving under the influence, reckless driving, or violating traffic laws
Mechanical or electrical failures not caused by collision or accident
Theft of personal belongings from the Vehicle

blocks.text: Even with damage protection, Renter remains responsible for:

items: {{renter_remaining_responsibility_1}}
{{renter_remaining_responsibility_2}}
{{renter_remaining_responsibility_3}}
Any damage exceeding the coverage limit of the protection plan.
Any damage not covered by the protection plan (per the exclusions above).
Any deductible or co-pay required under the protection plan.
Loss of use / rental income if not covered by the protection plan.
Any administrative or claims processing fees.
Fines, tickets, or penalties incurred during the rental.
{{renter_remaining_responsibility_extra}}

In the event of damage, Renter must follow the claims process in the main rental agreement (stop immediately, ensure safety, exchange information, take photos, notify Owner within {{accident_notification_hours}} hours, file police report if required).
Renter must also notify the protection plan provider: {{plan_provider_notification}}.
Renter should not admit fault or settle privately without consulting the protection plan provider.
Renter must cooperate fully with the claims adjuster and provide all requested documentation.
The protection plan provider will assess the claim and determine coverage.
{{claims_process_extra}}

blocks.text: Renter acknowledges having read, understood, and agreed to this Damage Protection Addendum. Renter confirms that they understand the coverage, limitations, and exclusions of the selected protection plan.
